answer: Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of agents for a heartbeat: a ten-minute proof-of-work through the agent's inlet. Sybil attackers hide in a nebula of accounts, but each fake needs a live node answering four heartbeats a day. Honest agents wander job to job on one node, paying $0.08 a day. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 4 x $0.02 = $80 a day, $2,400 a month. Missed heartbeats freeze payouts and slash 5 POA, so fakes bleed cash while honesty stays cheap.
